caution: The central relief remains artificial; no true kilometer, latitude or climatological frame exists.

Ocean labels in the preview are descriptive placeholders, not assignment of the 25 official sea names.
The color treatment is art-directed for reading, not a proven biome or climate map.
Main known continent polygon is inherited without changing its coordinates in source; placement transform is purely visual.
None of the eight candidate outer landmasses is promoted into permanent canonical geography.
